message: ボインなスタンプ

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, it's irresistible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop sniffing around.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soft boobies bouncing with every step she takes. Yours truly is head over heels.」

name: Synn
message: Where are you looking!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, thank you so much for earlier.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm so glad I can do Student Council activities with everyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see.」
Thanks to Paqy, my eyes keep accidentally straying to her chest.

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Blaming your own dirty mind on others, you really are something else.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not 'something else'!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, no, really. Coming up with an idea like that, as expected of this year's Student Council President.」
Being told that to my face makes me feel embarrassed.

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle. Don't be shy, don't be shy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-I'm not being shy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, yeah. His heart's just throbbing over Ria-chan's boobs.」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh!? Ah, n... no way...\s03」
Blushing, Ria-senpai covered her chest with her arms, but that only served to emphasize their size.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I have zero interest in b-boobs!」

name: Ria
message: 「...Having you deny it so completely makes me feel a bit conflicted, I guess...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah, well, it'd be a lie if I said I wasn't interested at all, yes!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see, you're a boy after all, Synn-kun.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't blame him for gettin' excited in front of you, Ria-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, just shut up already!」

name: Ria
message: 「But you know, if you keep staring at weird places, girls are gonna dislike you, okay~?」
In the end, I was completely wrapped around her finger.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, that's right!」
Senpai clapped her hands together in front of her chest.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, do you have your stamp card on you right now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, yeah, I do, but...」
I pulled out the card I had tucked inside my jacket's inner pocket.

name: Ria
message: 「You helped me out again today, so here you go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」
So this system is actually continuing.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan, me, me! Give one to the great me too!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... I don't have any spare stamp cards, sorry!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you say so, Ria-chan, I ain't got no choice! I'll hold back!」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't do anything in the first place...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now that we've officially become Student Council members, we gotta patrol with full energy!\s04」
In high spirits, Ria-senpai twirled around like she was dancing. Her chest bounced softly, keeping quite busy.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai. There's one thing I'm a bit concerned about.」

name: Ria
message: 「What is it? Your eyes are darting around, you know?」
That's your fault, Senpai!

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry, I'm not really confident about this, but... are Demons really like that?」
The one I saw yesterday was--
Yeah. It wasn't really that scary. In fact, it was cute and almost felt like something out of a fairytale.
However, what Ria-senpai drew was swirling madness, practically reminiscent of the end of the world.
What's more, the source wasn't clearly visible. The true form of those evil spirits didn't even exist in that drawing.
It's scary because staring at it feels like it'll haunt my dreams.

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't get a damn thing. Whatever Ria-chan does is always right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming from you, I'm not sure what to say...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... Was it really not a good likeness?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Ria-senpai slumps in disappointment.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, it's not that, really--」

name: Ria
message: 「I guess the body structure was a bit half-baked. I couldn't quite get a feel for it, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, body?」
I'll say it again: I couldn't perceive anything that could even be called a body.

name: Ria
message: 「True, the eyes were a bit off-center, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eyes, huh...」
I bet those eyes don't have a single spark of light in them.

name: Ria
message: 「Hnnn... Hmmm...」
Senpai pondered for a while after that, ultimately finishing another piece right on the spot.
Needless to say how that turned out.
